    AI Overview
    Kenneth Blakeney is the head men's basketball coach at Howard University, a position he has held since 2019. He has transformed the program, leading the Bison to consecutive MEAC Tournament titles (2023, 2024), back-to-back NCAA Tournament appearances, and the program's first-ever March Madness win. 
    This video shows Coach Blakeney discussing the team's NCAA Tournament appearance:
    58s
    HBCU LEGENDS
    YouTube • Mar 18, 2026
    Key Details About Coach Blakeney: 
    • Accomplishments: 2022-23 MEAC Coach of the Year, BOXTOROW HBCU Coach of the Year.
    • Record: Led Howard to three consecutive MEAC winning seasons (2021-24).
    • Background: Before joining Howard University, he held coaching roles at James Madison, Delaware, Seton Hall, and Harvard.
    • Playing Career: Blakeney was a standout player at Duke University. 
    His tenure has been characterized by building a strong team culture and securing consecutive tournament appearances.
